profile_text.body:
Hut 8 Corp. is a for-profit public company headquartered in Miami, Florida, trading under the ticker HUT. On its own site the company describes itself as owning, operating, and scaling purpose-built businesses that acquire, deploy, and monetize specialized hardware for next-generation, energy-intensive technologies. Through that portfolio, it says, it offers direct exposure to markets created by transformative technologies such as AI and Bitcoin mining.

The site also states that Hut 8 has fully commercialized its 1 GW Beacon Point AI Data Center Campus with a second 352 MW IT lease, which it says brings campus-level base-term contract value to $19.6 billion.

The company is registered with the SEC under CIK 0001964789. No lawsuits involving Hut 8 are recorded, and its litigation exposure is listed in Florida.
